tools.name: save_menu
tools.title: Save a menu to the draft look
tools.description: Saves the whole menu (Appearance area) into the draft look – visitors see it after publish_look. Items: {"type":"page","page_id":5,"text":""} (empty text = page name) | {"type":"link","text":"…","url":"https://… or /path","new_window":false} | {"type":"news"} | {"type":"group","text":"Services"} – each may have "children" (one submenu level), an "icon" (an Icon element name, e.g. "phone", or an SVG from Media: "media/…svg") and a "description" (up to 120 characters, shown under the label in a mega menu). A group inside a submenu may have its own "children": in a mega menu (Navigation element, mega_menu: true) it is a column headed by the group text. null = automatic main menu again. Hidden pages appear once visible.

tools.name: builder_schema
tools.title: Get the builder schema
tools.description: How a page is put together in the builder: element types and their fields, style properties, design system tokens (colours, spacing, type), the section library and the shared classes of the site. Load it before you first use the *_build tools. Returns a short overview (one element per line); full definitions of chosen elements through the elements parameter. The build JSON uses the builder’s own (Czech) keys: typ, znacka, obsah, styl, tridy, deti, kotva.

elements.description: element types to get the full definition for (field labels, default children), e.g. ["form","carousel"]

full.description: true = the whole schema with all labels (large)

tools.name: build_from_html
tools.title: Build from HTML
tools.description: RECOMMENDED for a new page or sections: write semantic HTML (section/header, h1–h3, p, ul, a, img, figure, blockquote, details) and put the look in a <style> block as rules of one class (.card { … }, .card:hover { … }) with tokens var(--ka-…); breakpoints from desktop down: @media (max-width: 1023px) = tablet, @media (max-width: 767px) = mobile. An element with a class from <style> gets no default style – layout (display:grid, gap) belongs in the class. It is converted to a build and classes; the result says what could not be converted. Saved as a draft. Accordions, tabs (role=tab), map and video frames, a form and data-counter numbers become their elements.

html.description: HTML of the content (without <html>/<head>); <style> may be inside. Build the header and footer from the logo, navigation and company details elements with save_build – HTML does not convert them.

id.description: Page ID; without it (and without part) a new hidden page is created with the name from title

title.description: Name of the new page (when there is no id)

mode.description: replace (default) = the whole build from the HTML | append = sections at the end of the existing build

overwrite_classes.description: true = classes that already exist on the site are overwritten by the <style>; otherwise they stay

publish.description: true = publish straight away (only when the user explicitly asks); otherwise a draft to preview

tools.name: list_redirects

tools.description: Redirects of old addresses (Redirects extension; auto_score = created by the site itself from a missing address with this confidence, null = by hand) and the most frequent addresses that ended with a 404 error, each with the page the visitor most likely meant (suggestion, score 0–100; 2.14) – save_redirect accepts it when the user agrees. Redirects by themselves: settings redirect_auto and redirect_auto_threshold.

tools.name: site_audit
tools.title: Audit the site
tools.description: Site audit (read-only). sample: placeholders in square brackets, sample testimonials, figures and texts still on published pages – replace them with the owner's real content or delete them, never with invented ones. link: links to missing pages, broken external links (list_broken_links). orphan: pages nothing links to (suggest_internal_links). description, title (duplicates), menu (items to hidden pages), build (buttons without a link, images without alt, heading outline), not_found (frequent 404s without a redirect). Each finding has its target (page / collection+item / part / component / popup / news / menu / redirect_from) and, for builds, the element id – fix it with the usual tools, then run the audit again. accessibility (EAA, WCAG 2.2 AA): design system contrast, link and button texts that do not say where they lead, images without alt, empty links, tables without header cells, frames without a title, no accessibility statement. handover: SMTP tested, off-site backups, company details, indexing, icon, tracking without consent, security contact, two-step sign-in, accounts unused for 90 days and Claude connections for 60, automatic suspension, client account, report recipient, guardrails, agency contact, Notebook, cron, SPF/DMARC, certificate and domain expiry; handover_checklist = every row with done; move (on a site with imported pages or a migration report) = where the move stands: pages imported and published, imported pages not reworked yet, sample pages left, redirects, the newest migration report (errors, lost forms, addresses on sample pages) and its rows with done. speed: pages whose real-user p75 LCP got worse by over a quarter against the previous 30 days (get_stats → web_vitals). review: pages, news, collection items and pop-ups whose review_by day has come (valid_until and review_by of create_page, update_page, create_news, update_news, save_collection_item, save_popup). job: a visible job without a closing date – search engines need validThrough and it never hides itself (valid_until of save_collection_item).

kind.description: only one kind: link | orphan | menu | description | title | build | review | job | document | accessibility | not_found | speed | fact | blueprint | handover (optional)

tools.name: layout_queue
tools.title: List and tick off layouts to rebuild
tools.description: The work queue of a move (3.36, users with Pages): the imported pages whose layout is not rebuilt yet – their build is still the imported text – each with old_url, its address on the old site for read_old_page. Rebuild a page (read_old_page with format semantic, then build_from_html with its id) and it leaves the queue by itself with the first change of its build; done: [page IDs] takes pages off the queue whose layout is fine as it came – nothing on the page changes, and it is not part of undoing a session.

done.description: IDs of pages whose layout is done as it is (optional; without it the tool only lists)

offset.description: skip this many waiting pages (up to 50 are listed per call; next_offset gives the next)

tools.name: find_tools
tools.title: Find more tools
tools.description: Finds the other tools of this site (3.10). This connection lists a short set only; every other tool it may use (news, redirects, settings, health, bookings, newsletters…) is found here. Without arguments: a short index (name, access, runner, one line each). With query (a few words, e.g. "redirect 404") or names (exact tool names): the full definitions, up to 8, each with the runner to call it with.
